decision.rationale: The created activity omits participants_min. Status assertions, populated fixtures and patch behavior do not establish field-presence obligations for empty POST creation; the intended response contract remains unresolved.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: The nullable participantsMin field is inspected at ActivityProperties:85–86. Populated creation fixtures and a separate PATCH do not establish whether empty-create output may omit it; the global NON_NULL serializer is context only.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
